title: Warranty Periods
details: Smartphones are covered for 12 months, laptops for 12 months, tablets for 12 months, headphones for 6 months, and home appliances for 24 months. Accidental damage is excluded from standard warranties. Premium members receive an extra 6 months of warranty on all electronics.

title: Membership Benefits
details: Basic membership is free and includes free standard shipping on orders over 50 USD and 30-day returns. Prime membership costs 9.99 USD per month and includes free standard delivery on all orders, discounted express shipping, early deal access, and free return pickup. Premium membership costs 19.99 USD per month and includes free express delivery, extended 45-day returns, 6 extra months of warranty on electronics, and 24/7 phone support.
